evidence.note: Trailing slash differs from the configured IdP entity ID; exact string comparison fails.
Assertion issuer has the same trailing-slash difference.

output.fix: Make the SP's configured IdP entity ID match the Issuer the IdP actually sends, character for character. Take the value from the IdP's metadata, which is the Entra "Microsoft Entra Identifier" or "Identifier" value. Here that means either updating the SP config to "https://idp.example.com/saml/" or changing the IdP's identifier to drop the trailing slash. Don't loosen the comparison, and keep signature validation on with the pinned IdP certificate. Also confirm that the new Entra signing certificate is the one pinned on the SP, since a migration usually changes it.

alternatives.why_not: Signature validity was not shown to fail. The embedded certificate matches the configured one, and the only deterministic difference is the Issuer string.
